The image shows a tomato leaf with circular to irregular dark spots, each with a lighter center (pycnidia visible as white/gray dots) surrounded by dark brown-black borders. This is the classic presentation of Septoria leaf spot caused by *Septoria lycopersici* (closely related to *S. albopunctata* shown here). The image label confirms "Septoria leaf spot."

Among the provided classes, the closest match is **Septoria_Leaf_Blotch**.
